map.基于 GAGS（Global Acne Grading System）标准，对6: Based on the GAGS (Global Acne Grading System) standard, score the most severe lesion in 6 regions and combine regional factors to compute global acne severity.
map.GAGS = Σ(各部位最重皮损评分 × 局部因子): GAGS = Σ(most severe lesion score per region × regional factor)
map.各部位最严重皮损类型: Most severe lesion type per region
map.GAGS = Σ(各部位最重皮损评分 × 局部因子)。局部因子：前额/双颊/胸部: GAGS = Σ(most severe lesion score per region × regional factor). Regional factors: forehead / both cheeks / chest / upper back = 2, nose / jaw = 1. Lesion scores: 0 none, 1 comedone, 2 papule, 3 pustule, 4 nodule. Maximum 48.
map.分区计数：录入各体区粉刺、丘疹、脓疱、结节囊肿的数量，并按该区最重皮损类型赋权重: Regional counting: enter the counts of comedones, papules, pustules, and nodulocysts per body region and weight by the most severe lesion type there (comedone 1, papule 2, pustule 3, nodule 4); the tool weights and sums.
map.严重度分层：依总分区分轻度（1–18）、中度（19–30）、重度（31–38）与: Severity stratification: by total score, mild (1-18), moderate (19-30), severe (31-38), very severe (>38), helping choose topical or oral medication paths.
map.疗效随访：治疗前后复评，观察结节/囊肿权重项是否下降，判断系统治疗是否见效。: Efficacy follow-up: re-score before and after treatment and watch whether the nodule/cyst weighted items fall, to judge if systemic therapy works.
map.示例：下面部丘疹 8 个（权重 2）+ 结节 2 个（权重 4）、前胸脓疱 5: Example: lower-face 8 papules (weight 2) + 2 nodules (weight 4), anterior chest 5 pustules (weight 3) → the tool computes the total GAGS and judges it moderate-severe, suggesting topical plus oral when needed.
map.GAGS 和寻常分级有啥区别？: How does GAGS differ from ordinary grading?
map.GAGS 按体区计数并给最重皮损加权，比单纯「轻中重」更量化，便于前后对比与分型: GAGS counts by region and weights the most severe lesion, more quantitative than a simple 'mild/moderate/severe', and easier for before-after comparison and typing.
